svg.title: Rule-based and unsupervised uses in the map
svg.desc: Enlarged excerpt preserving all 29 tool columns and eight stages for the rule-based and unsupervised families. The exceptions remain visible in their original colours. This selection is not a complete market census. Individual tool identities and function assignments remain in metadata.
